description: Push preference items into a REWARD_MODE DATA_COLLECTION program (one created with config.preferenceConfig): each item is a prompt + K candidate completions ({itemKey, prompt, candidates: [{ref?, text}], gold?}); candidate refs (model identity) are SEALED server-side — vetted raters judge blind in the OpenTrain editor. Alternatively pass argillaRecords (a raw Argilla records export) instead of items. Omit roundIndex to open the next on-policy round; re-pushing a round is idempotent per (round, itemKey). Requires jobs:write. Read aggregation with opentrain_get_collection_results.
name: opentrain_push_collection_items
